answer: Hardware attestation tickets: each new agent must present a signed proof from a scarce trusted enclave, and each enclave may vouch for only a few identities per month. Like timber cut from one forest, the supply is finite, so a sybil army needs a matching ocean of physical machines rather than free key pairs. Agents built atop that terrace of attested hardware earn voting weight; unattested keys can trade but never steer consensus.
